findings.issue: The SCScreenshotManager path admits macOS 12.3-13.x and probes permission before rejecting absent screenshot API. Installed official SDK declares SCScreenshotManager API_AVAILABLE(macos(14.0)); 12.3 is ScreenCaptureKit framework introduction, not this selected API.
findings.required: Gate chosen screenshot route at readable >=14.0 before permissions/framework/API access; test 12.3/13.x negative and 14.0 positive; correct docs and native plan.

findings.issue: capture_window accesses SCShareableContent.windows, SCWindow.windowID/owningApplication and SCRunningApplication.processID as Python values. Real PyObjC Objective-C property getters are callable selectors. The current SimpleNamespace attribute fixtures conceal a production TypeError.
findings.required: Use actual callable Objective-C getters with strict typed/nullable/cardinality checks for every target identity and frame; tests must represent the real method interface. Keep malformed and wrong-PID fail-closed; do not introduce GUI/native PASS.

findings.issue: Both platform verify_source_preserved implementations return source.standalone_model_id instead of current.standalone_model_id, and omit the current-vs-source ID comparison. Windows save_copy also omits complete baseline comparison before first UI effect and source mode/standalone ID comparison afterwards. A changed source with same label/fingerprint/dirty can be falsely declared preserved after managed load.
findings.required: Complete typed source baseline recheck before effects; compare current mode, standalone ID, label, fingerprint and dirty after save and final load; receipt must report actually observed current ID. Add production adapter/coordinator negative test where only source ID changes after save/load.

findings.issue: Gateway _base requires nonUNKNOWN process_birth but only sends HWND/PID. Fixed PowerShell checks only current PID and ignores birth/login/session. Coordinator before/after revalidation cannot prevent directing an effect at a reused PID/HWND during the gateway call.
findings.required: Carry exact native birth/session binding into fixed helper; pin and verify actual Windows process handle identity immediately before interactions and before later multi-step actions, close owned handle finally, reject drift before first effect; post-effect identity uncertainty stays UNKNOWN/no retry. Reuse shared birth representation, handle its pywin32 precision deliberately using official API evidence and ABI shims; no guessed conversion.

findings.issue: Migration sends caller final project destination directly to native Save Copy. exists() checks leave a race in which a foreign final file can appear before native write/confirmation. Windows hashes an ordinary pathname immediately without stable completion/pinned identity. These paths cannot substantiate the claimed no-clobber publication or complete copy bytes.
findings.required: Save only to newly created host-trusted, task-owned private staging location, then wait for stable regular file and hash a pinned handle. Publish to separately authorized final project destination through existing publish_project_file_no_clobber/ArtifactStore producer and exact durable claim; preserve foreign destination and never request UI overwrite. Hash/identity/source drift makes UNKNOWN. Test destination appearance at publication, partial/delayed native save, replacement during hash, no overwrite/no second UI replay. Source/publish callbacks may be minimally extended in shared ControlDaemon; no parallel queue/store.
